name: ShasTech SEO Synergy
author: Md Ariful Islam

sections.description:
ShasTech SEO Synergy is a lightweight WordPress SEO plugin designed for news publishers, blogs, and content-heavy websites.

The plugin provides editable metadata, canonical URLs, Open Graph and X/Twitter cards, structured data, XML sitemaps, a Google News sitemap, Content Intelligence, local Performance SEO checks, IndexNow submissions, internal-link suggestions, redirects, 404 logging, site verification, and author/publisher signals.

Main features

  • Manual or automatic SEO titles and descriptions.
  • Optional meta keywords for editorial workflows.
  • Canonical and robots controls for posts, pages, and taxonomies.
  • Organization, NewsMediaOrganization, WebSite, WebPage, CollectionPage, Article, NewsArticle, Person, ProfilePage, and BreadcrumbList schema.
  • Standard XML, image, and Google News sitemaps with caching.
  • IndexNow submissions with queueing, limits, status, and per-post history.
  • Open Graph article metadata and X/Twitter cards.
  • Primary-category support for breadcrumbs and article sections.
  • Google, Bing, Yandex, Pinterest, and Facebook verification metadata.
  • Optional virtual verification files.
  • Internal-link suggestions, placement hints, and overlink warnings.
  • Media ALT helper for selected images.
  • Exact-match redirects with hit counts.
  • Privacy-conscious 404 logging without IP-address storage.
  • Advanced author profiles and Person schema.
  • Local Content Intelligence for topics, phrases, entities, context, and E-E-A-T signals.
  • Per-content Performance SEO scans for Core Web Vitals readiness, lazy loading, image optimization, and blocking assets.
  • Optional complete data cleanup on uninstall.

Important notes

ShasTech SEO Synergy prevents activation while supported conflicting SEO plugins are active. Deactivate other full SEO plugins before activation to avoid duplicate metadata and schema.

Search engines decide whether and how content is indexed or displayed. The plugin improves technical signals but cannot guarantee rankings, Google News inclusion, or Google Discover traffic.

External services

ShasTech SEO Synergy can send published or updated URLs to the IndexNow endpoint operated by Microsoft Bing when IndexNow is enabled. The request contains the site’s hostname, the URLs being submitted, the site’s IndexNow key, and the public key-file location. No visitor data is sent.

Service: IndexNow / Microsoft Bing
Endpoint: https://www.bing.com/indexnow
IndexNow terms: https://www.indexnow.org/terms
Microsoft privacy statement: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement

The verification status tool may make a server-side request to the site’s own homepage and configured virtual verification file. It does not send that test data to ShasTech SEO Synergy or ShasTech-IT.

The Performance SEO tool only runs when an authorized editor clicks the scan button. It makes a server-side request to the selected post’s public URL on the same WordPress site, analyzes up to 2 MB of returned HTML, and stores the latest report in post metadata. It does not send the page or report to ShasTech SEO Synergy, ShasTech-IT, or another external service.

Privacy

The optional 404 logger stores the requested path, a query-free referrer URL when available, hit counts, and first/last-seen timestamps. It does not store visitor IP addresses or user-agent strings in version 5.0. Site administrators can clear the log at any time.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the shastech-seo-synergy folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin ZIP in WordPress.
  2. Deactivate any conflicting full SEO plugin.
  3. Activate ShasTech SEO Synergy.
  4. Open ShasTech SEO Synergy in the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Review organization, sitemap, indexing, Google News, IndexNow, verification, and editorial settings.
  6. Save WordPress permalinks once if a sitemap endpoint returns a 404.
sections.faq:
Can I run ShasTech SEO Synergy with Yoast, Rank Math, or AIOSEO?

No. Running two full SEO plugins can create duplicate titles, canonical tags, robots directives, Open Graph tags, and structured data.

Does ShasTech SEO Synergy guarantee Google News or Discover placement?

No. It provides technical SEO and publisher signals, but Google determines eligibility and visibility.

Does the Google News sitemap include every post?

No. It includes eligible, recently published content according to the configured time window and exclusions.

Does IndexNow submit URLs to Google?

IndexNow is supported by participating search engines. It is not a Google indexing API.

Does the plugin collect visitor IP addresses?

No. Version 5.0 does not store IP addresses in the 404 log.

Does Performance SEO show real Core Web Vitals values?

No. The local scan checks readiness signals in rendered HTML, including likely LCP image delivery, image and iframe dimensions, lazy-loading attributes, and potentially blocking CSS and JavaScript. Real LCP, CLS, and INP values require browser-based laboratory testing or field data.

What happens when the plugin is uninstalled?

By default, SEO data is preserved. Enable the uninstall-cleanup option before uninstalling to remove plugin settings, metadata, logs, queues, redirects, and custom tables.
sections.changelog:
6.2.1

  • Renamed the plugin to ShasTech SEO Synergy and changed the requested directory slug to shastech-seo-synergy.
  • Replaced short global, declaration, hook, asset, request, and stored-data prefixes with the unique shastech_seosy prefix.
  • Updated the plugin folder, bootstrap file, text domain, translation template, menu slugs, and asset handles.
  • Hardened JSON-LD output by using wp_json_encode without unsafe unescaped-slash flags.
  • Updated uninstall cleanup for the newly prefixed data keys and custom tables.

6.2.0

  • Added a per-content Performance SEO tab and local rendered-page scanner.
  • Added Core Web Vitals readiness scores and actionable LCP, CLS, and INP hints.
  • Added a lazy-load analyzer for images and iframes.
  • Added image optimization reporting for dimensions, responsive candidates, formats, and local file sizes.
  • Added CSS and JavaScript blocking reports for stylesheets, synchronous head scripts, third-party scripts, and inline payloads.
  • Added likely LCP image detection, priority checks, preload detection, and layout-stability guidance.
  • Added saved per-post performance reports with stale-report notices and manual rescanning.
  • Kept all scans local to the WordPress site with no external performance API.

6.1.2

  • Fixed Bangla tokenization by preserving Unicode combining marks used by vowel signs and conjunct forms.
  • Prevented words such as ইনকিলাব, অবরোধ, অবস্থান, and উপদেষ্টা from splitting into partial fragments.
  • Fixed Content Intelligence topic labels being visually clipped in narrow editor panels.
  • Improved topic-chip wrapping and count layout for Bangla, Arabic, and long English terms.
  • Distinguished zero-count editorial topics from content frequency counts.

6.1.1

  • Replaced Bangla fixed-length topic stems with conservative suffix normalization.
  • Preserved complete readable Bangla topic words.
  • Added ranked two-word and three-word phrase extraction.
  • Improved Bangla stop-word filtering and topic deduplication.
  • Added an Important Phrases panel to Content Intelligence.
  • Hid misleading zero-count badges for editorial topics.

6.1.0

  • Added local Content Intelligence analysis.
  • Added related topic and entity detection.
  • Added content coverage and E-E-A-T checks.
  • Added actionable coverage gap recommendations.

6.0.1

  • Removed the final Plugin Check filesystem-operation error from Audit CSV export.
  • Renamed the IndexNow queue hook with the full ShasTech SEO Synergy prefix.
  • Prefixed bootstrap and uninstall variables for WordPress coding standards.

6.0.0

  • Added a resumable full-site SEO Audit Center.
  • Added batch scanning for metadata, thin content, indexing, images, links, duplicate snippets, and possible orphan content.
  • Added local CSV export for audit findings.
  • Added a documented module registry for optional extensions.
  • Kept all core SEO, News, sitemap, redirect, and analysis features fully functional.

5.3.0

  • Added a local rule-based SEO Assistant with title, description, keyword, section, heading, image ALT, FAQ, and readability suggestions.
  • Added one-click apply and copy actions in the post editor.
  • Added English, Bangla, and Arabic suggestion templates.
  • Removed the prohibited suppress_filters query parameter from the dashboard widget.

5.2.2

  • Added image SEO readiness checks.
  • Added schema readiness validation.
  • Added Google News and Discover readiness checks.
  • Added a ShasTech SEO Synergy dashboard overview widget.

5.2.1

  • Added live Google search preview.
  • Added Facebook and X/Twitter social previews.
  • Added effective canonical URL analysis.
  • Added live URL checks for HTTPS, length, lowercase slugs, query strings, and focus-keyword usage.
  • Added responsive and dark-mode-compatible preview styling.

5.2.0

  • Added the Phase 1 SEO Analysis Engine.
  • Added a per-content focus keyword field.
  • Added a weighted SEO score from 0 to 100.
  • Added word, reading-time, paragraph, image, link, and heading statistics.
  • Added multilingual-friendly keyword placement and density checks.
  • Added readability indicators for sentence and paragraph length.
  • Removed the internal-link post exclusion and taxonomy query performance warnings.

5.1.1

  • Completed translator comments required by Plugin Check.
  • Polished settings spacing and post-editor cards.
  • Added compatibility styles for common WordPress admin dark-mode implementations.
  • Prepared WordPress.org icon, banner, and screenshot capture assets.

5.1.0

  • Redesigned the post editor SEO metabox with tabs, readiness score, live character counters, and search preview.
  • Redesigned internal-link suggestions as actionable cards.
  • Added Insert Link support for Classic Editor, Text editor, and compatible Gutenberg paragraph blocks.
  • Improved responsive admin styling and editor feedback states.

5.0.5

  • Reduced remaining Plugin Check warnings for submission readiness.
  • Removed dynamic ORDER BY fragments from the 404 Log queries.
  • Added signed admin filter, prefill, import-result, and IndexNow notice URLs.
  • Improved remaining request sanitization.
  • Documented intentional custom-table, migration, and uninstall queries.
  • Synchronized plugin version constants and metadata.

5.0.3

  • Fixed Plugin Check security, escaping, i18n, and deprecated API findings.
  • Improved Google News sitemap diagnostics and recent-post query handling.
  • Updated compatibility declaration for WordPress 7.0 after staging validation.

5.0.2

  • Expanded translation coverage across admin workflows.
  • Moved shared admin JavaScript and primary settings styles to scoped asset files.
  • Improved request handling and Plugin Check compatibility.
  • Localized IndexNow notices and internal-link tools.

5.0.1

  • Reorganized the settings screen into accessible tabs.
  • Began full internationalization using the shastech-seo-synergy text domain.
  • Added a translation template under /languages.

  • Added a versioned installer and database-upgrade routine.
  • Improved activation, deactivation, rewrite-rule, and cron lifecycle handling.
  • Added opt-in complete uninstall cleanup.
  • Fixed taxonomy conflict-warning rendering.
  • Removed an accidental development ZIP from the release package.
  • Hardened request sanitization and nonce handling.
  • Stopped storing visitor IP addresses in the 404 log.

4.0.0
